about: The C-360 with spanning tree on, before ustp is installed (0095): the kernel's own STP has no edge ports and would hold each Wi-Fi network at every start, so the bridge stays as it is, the renderer says why, and the render check refuses the config until the agent has ustp in.
errors: uplink.stp: spanning tree needs ustp, for RSTP, which the agent is installing; the bridge stays as it is until then
